name: suede-launch-packaging
description: Suede-owned launch packaging and install verification. Use when finished software work needs a clean public package — README, docs page, install command, release note, GitHub Pages update, skill-pack release, MCP server, or launch/social copy — or when a release needs handoff notes, an install fails, a public user cannot add a skill, a raw-vs-blob URL returns HTML, or `@personal` or a local plugin alias leaks into public docs. Verifies the live URL and runs the exact install command from a clean
author: JasonColapietro
summary_zh: 一套软件发布打包与安装验收工具，适合整理公开文档、发布说明，并在干净环境中验证链接和安装流程。
